messages.subject: Can radioButtons be ordered horizontally
parts: Does not appear to be an option currently?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Can radioButtons be ordered horizontally
parts:
Try adding this somewhere in your UI:

tags$head(tags$style(type="text/css",
  "label.radio { display: inline-block; }",
  ".radio input[type=\"radio\"] { float: none; }"
))
On Fri, Dec 14, 2012 at 10:15 AM, Andrew Clark <scott.r...@gmail.com> wrote:
Does not appear to be an option currently?
--
